quest.title: Facing Distant Echoes
quest.description: The prep work is complete. Now all that is left is to head into the ruins to confront those mysterious ancient machines...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x50, Hero's Wit x2, Mora x20000

dialogues.speaker: Muzhen
dialogues.text: Well, looks like we've finally located our target! Great! Guess I can go back to the ship and get some sleep!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What? You're gonna leave just like that?

dialogues.speaker: Muzhen
dialogues.text: Of course not, we're so close! Let's head out right now and capture ourselves a Ruin machine!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, and here Paimon thought you were going to return to the ship!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: *sigh* Well, never mind. Let's follow her!

dialogues.speaker: Muzhen
dialogues.text: To think that there would be underground ruins here too... *gulp*

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You don't look so good. Are you unwell?

response.speaker: Muzhen
response.text: Haha. I just don't normally get off the boat, so this ruin entrance is... well, quite a sight.

response.speaker: Muzhen
response.text: S—Still, the Captain's order still needs completing. I'm sure you're really curious as to what treasures lie within as well, aren't you, Traveler?

response.speaker: Muzhen
response.text: So, could I invite you, experienced and skilled as you are, to take the lead?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That she is! Come on, Traveler, lets go!

dialogues.speaker: Muzhen
dialogues.text: Hmm? Do you need to warm up or anything?

choices.text: Can you tell me anything about these ruins?

response.speaker: Muzhen
response.text: Well, I'm a Technical Officer, so I don't know much about world history, I'm afraid.

response.speaker: Muzhen
response.text: Nonetheless, I believe these ruins to be related to the great disaster that occurred five hundred years ago...

response.speaker: Muzhen
response.text: I grew up listening to old sailors tell that tale, you know? They said that neither land nor sea could escape the reach of the Abyss...

response.speaker: Muzhen
response.text: But to me, those were no different from the ghost stories they tell to scare children.

response.speaker: Muzhen
response.text: I mean, only the terrors you can see are true, after all!

choices.text: Do you know anything about those mysterious machines?
